audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer treats Defiant Dance as a defensive block you must bait ('her W only blocks one burst direction — bait it before you commit', repeated in whys[3] and whys[5]), and the full layer is untouched template calling Irelia 'him' in six places.
audit.why: Riot's Defiant Dance text: 'She takes reduced PHYSICAL damage during the charge.' Galio is a magic-damage champion — Winds of War, Colossal Smash's bonus, the Shield of Durand release. Her W does nothing to your burst, so there is nothing to bait: it is purely her damage tool here, and the advice to hold your combo for it costs you the trade.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance now stated as physical-only reduction that your magic ignores, in the level-3 spike, wants.you, mid and both whys; pronouns fixed throughout the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vanguard's Edge does not appear anywhere in either layer — the full layer says 'Reassess his ultimate too'.
audit.why: Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85 and, after the blades hit, forms a wall that damages and slows anything walking through it. That wall is what turns a lost skirmish into a death for a 650-range dash champion, and it is her real level-6 and late-game spike.
audit.corrected: Vanguard's Edge named in the level-6 spike, the late spike, the late text and the full layer's level-6 phase, with its 125s rank-1 cooldown and the wall behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the don't claims Flawless Duet 'catches you mid-dash'.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 at 850 range — the one cooldown in her kit long enough to plan around. Bladesurge is 10s but refreshes on a Marked or dying target, so it is not a window you can wait out. Nothing in Riot's text supports the mid-dash claim.
audit.corrected: 16s Flawless Duet and the 'Bladesurge refreshes on Marked or dying targets' caveat now carried in the cooldown block, do's, don'ts, trading rules and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math' named no source.
audit.why: The heal is Bladesurge, which heals her on every cast and refreshes on Marked targets — flagged as needs-antiheal in _missing-interactions.json. It is a reset-driven heal, so it scales with how long the fight lasts, not with her item count.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names Bladesurge and ties the Orb to extended fights.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing explains what makes Bladesurge reset, so 'before she can Q-reset off a minion' reads like a guess.
audit.why: Riot: 'If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.' Marks come from Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge — so the reset chain is gated on her landing CC first, not on the wave alone.
audit.corrected: Written into the foe-wants line and the mid text as 'resets off a Marked target or a dying minion'.

edits.before: "Your level 1 is one of the worst in the game — a single ability and no engage — so Irelia owns the opening with her Q-dash poke and her passive attack-speed stacks. Do not contest level 2: her Q-dash and E two-blade stun let her start a trade before your combo exists. The lane flips at 3 once Q-W-E is up — bait her Q-dash onto you, hold Shield of Durand to soak the all-in she commits, then release the taunt into the E-knockup. Her empowered on-hit autos deal bonus magic damage, which your W's magic damage reduction is built to blunt, so the W is for the stun-lock and your burst window — not for face-tanking her autos forever."
edits.after: Your level 1 is one of the worst in the game — a single ability and no engage — so Irelia owns the opening with Bladesurge poke and Ionian Fervor attack-speed stacks. Do not contest level 2: Bladesurge plus the Flawless Duet stun let her start a trade before your combo exists. The lane flips at 3 once Q-W-E is up — bait Bladesurge onto you, hold Shield of Durand through the all-in she commits, then release the taunt into the knockup. Her empowered on-hit deals bonus damage your W blunts, and note her own Defiant Dance only reduces physical, so it never protects her from your magic.

edits.before: "Levels 3 through 6 are yours. Every time she Q-dashes in to start a trade she hands you the taunt-and-knockup punish, and her W (Bladesurge's defensive cousin, Defiant Dance) only blocks one burst direction — bait it before you commit. Hold your E to interrupt her Q-reset chain off the wave; if her E two-blade stun catches you first, your Shield of Durand channel still ramps damage reduction so you survive the follow-up. At 6, Hero's Entrance is your real spike: even in an even lane, flag your jungler or a sidelane and drop the landing knockup-and-taunt, because your map value beats her solo snowball."
edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 are yours. Every time she Bladesurges in to open a trade she hands you the taunt-and-knockup punish, and there is nothing to bait first — Defiant Dance reduces physical damage only, so your whole kit lands through it. Hold Justice Punch for her reset chain instead: Bladesurge refreshes off a Marked target or a dying minion, so she is only stuck when she has neither. If Flawless Duet (16s) catches you first, the Shield of Durand channel still ramps reduction so you survive the follow-up. At 6, flag Hero's Entrance to a sidelane — your map value beats her solo snowball.

edits.before: "She out-scales you in the straight duel. Past two items her Q gives near-infinite resets in a fight and her stacked passive attack speed plus empowered on-hit shred chew through your tank stats, so a 1v1 sidelane against her is a loss you should not take. Your job late is not to box her — it's to use Hero's Entrance to win the 5v5 she isn't in, taunt her carries off the engage, and let your team punish her splitpush. Group, don't duel."
edits.after: She out-scales you in the straight duel. Past two items Bladesurge gives near-endless resets in a fight, Ionian Fervor stacks her attack speed, and Vanguard's Edge drops a wall that damages and slows anything walking through it, so a 1v1 sidelane against her is a loss you should not take. Your job late is not to box her — use Hero's Entrance to win the 5v5 she isn't in, taunt her carries off the engage, and let your team punish her splitpush. Group, don't duel.

notes: Biggest correction: the page told a Galio to bait out Irelia's Defiant Dance before committing. Riot's text says Defiant Dance gives reduced PHYSICAL damage while charging — against Galio's all-magic kit it has no defensive value at all, so holding your combo for it just gives her a free charged strike. That misconception appeared in wants.you, mid, whys[3] and whys[5]. Second: Vanguard's Edge was absent from both layers; it is 125s at rank 1 and leaves a wall that damages and slows anything walking through it, which is the reason a sidelane 1v1 against her late is unrecoverable. Third: Bladesurge refreshes specifically on a Marked or dying target, so her reset chain is gated on her landing Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge first. NOT WRITTEN: champ-data/_kits/irelia.json carries a derived 'grounding' flag on Flawless Duet and _missing-interactions.json builds 'Irelia can deny your mobility (Justice Punch) with Flawless Duet' from it, but Riot's description only says damaged, stunned and Marked — no grounding — so I trusted the description and left that claim off the page.
